    • joint

      void joint(double x, double y, double radius)
      Draws the filler beneath a connected body bend.
      Parameters:
      x - centre x coordinate in cell units
      y - centre y coordinate in cell units
      radius - joint radius in cell units

    • strip

      void strip(double x, double y, double angle, double length, double offset, boolean tail)
      Draws a section of the body or tail sprite along the path.
      Parameters:
      x - strip origin x in cell units
      y - strip origin y in cell units
      angle - clockwise rotation in degrees
      length - strip length in cell units
      offset - fractional offset into the current sprite cell
      tail - true when this strip belongs to the first tail cell
